```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Todo List</title>
    @livewireStyles
    <style>
        /* Add your custom Tailwind CSS styles here */
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container mx-auto p-4">
        <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold mb-4">Todo List</h1>
        <form wire:submit.prevent="addTodo">
            <input type="text" name="todo" placeholder="Add new todo" wire:model="newTodo" class="w-full rounded-md border border-gray-200 px-4 py-2 shadow-sm focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-none" />
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary mt-4">Add</button>
        </form>

        <ul class="list-disc list-inside mt-6">
            @foreach ($todos as $todo)
                <li wire:key="{{ $todo->id }}">{{ $todo->text }}</li>
            @endforeach
        </ul>

        <div x-data="{ showDeleteModal: false }" x-show="showDeleteModal" class="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black bg-opacity-50 z-10">
            <div class="absolute top-2 left-2 right-2 bottom-2 p-8 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md">
                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Delete Todo</h3>
                <p>Are you sure you want to delete this todo?</p>
                <button @click="showDeleteModal = false" class="btn btn-secondary mt-4 mr-auto w-full">Cancel</button>
                <button @click="deleteTodo($event)" class="btn btn-primary mt-2">Delete</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <script src="{{ asset('js/app.js') }}"></script>
    </div>

    @livewireScripts
</body>
</html>
```

This Blade view includes a form for adding new todos, a list of existing todos, and a modal for deleting individual todos. The Tailwind CSS styles are included to ensure the UI looks professional and beautiful. Alpine.js is used for handling form submission and modal interactions.
